calculation.description: Prior completed 20-session price trend weighted by a positive shock in prior-session volume relative to the preceding 20-session median. Positive values favor continuation; zero when volume does not confirm the trend. All inputs are lagged to avoid future-data leakage.

validation.regime_notes: Broad 15-asset cross-asset validation with at least 8 valid names/date; daily admission clears benchmark thresholds, but coverage is reduced by missing/zero volume and IC uncertainty is material in the small cross-section. Regime-level follow-up and artifact correlation screening are required.
